# Independent rederivation of the original-row identities

This checks `candidate 9e43ca1dd488e8cb` by two alternate formulations. Defect's separate full audit is `unshared historical review/context (not an accepted premise)`. Verdict: **PASS**.

## 1. Covariance as a general size-bias identity

For any probability law rho, positive bounded random variable W and integrable vector X, let d rho^W=W d rho/E_rho W. Directly from the definition of covariance,

    E_(rho^W)X-E_rho X=Cov_rho(X,W)/E_rho W.

Apply this generic identity with W=L, X=w, E_rho w=Y_i, and E_rho L=L_i. Contact with an affine plane of gradient a_i gives Cov(w,L)=Cov(w)a_i and Var(L)=a_i^T Cov(w)a_i. This rederives both the vector displacement and its nonnegative projection. If the displacement vanishes, its projection vanishes, hence L is constant almost surely; the converse is immediate. This verifies all four equality conditions without assuming a nonsingular covariance matrix.

Two different active planes differ by a function zero almost surely on the row, so their centered linear parts have covariance zero. The displacement is therefore independent of that choice, including rows supported on proper base faces.

## 2. Entropy as a joint-law chain rule

On the product of the source index and actual target space, define probability laws

    P(i,dw)=sigma_i bar_rho_i(dw)=q_i(w)dm(w)/M,
    Q(i,dw)=sigma_i rho_i(dw).

They have the SAME source marginal sigma. Their Radon–Nikodym ratio is L(w)/L_i. Therefore

    KL(P||Q)=integral log L dm/M-sum_i sigma_i log L_i
            =-sum_i sigma_i log L_i.

The entropy chain rule with the common source marginal gives

    KL(P||Q)=sum_i sigma_i KL(bar_rho_i||rho_i).

This independently proves the exact reserve and its sign. Equality of the joint laws is precisely rowwise equality of the tilted and original laws. Strict positivity and compactness justify finiteness throughout.

Finally s log s has second derivative 1/s. Applying the quadratic Taylor remainder between 1 and L/L_i, using the row minimum and maximum of L and mean L/L_i=1, gives exactly the displayed constants 1/(2L_i U_i) and 1/(2L_i l_i). The nonzero continuous-gradient strictness follows from absolute continuity on each fiber, not a positive-definiteness assumption on full-space covariance.

These identities remain parameter-transport identities. Neither proof supplies a physical cap response or a per-label Gamma estimate.
